_comment: Well-known official forms: what each is, who issues it, and the official page. Each opens the form-explainer skill. Add forms people commonly receive or must fill in, with the issuer's official URL; describe only what the form is, not personal advice.

forms.name: P45: details of employee leaving work
forms.what: Given by an employer when you stop working there: your pay and tax so far this tax year and your tax code. Give the right part to your next employer.

forms.name: P60: end of year certificate
forms.what: Given by your employer after the tax year ends if you still work there: your total pay and tax for the year. Keep it as proof of income and for tax refunds.

forms.name: SA100: Self Assessment tax return
forms.what: The main tax return for people who file Self Assessment, for example the self-employed. Most people file it online.

forms.name: Form W-4: Employee's Withholding Certificate
forms.what: Tells your employer how much federal income tax to withhold from your pay. Filled in when you start a job or your situation changes.

forms.name: Form W-2: Wage and Tax Statement
forms.what: Sent by your employer after the year ends: your wages and the taxes withheld. You need it to file your tax return.

forms.name: Form 1040: U.S. Individual Income Tax Return
forms.what: The standard federal income tax return for individuals.

forms.name: Form I-9: Employment Eligibility Verification
forms.what: Completed when you start a job: confirms your identity and that you may work in the US, with documents you show your employer.

forms.name: Form 16: TDS certificate for salary
forms.what: Given by your employer: your salary and the tax deducted at source (TDS) during the year. You use it to file your income tax return.

forms.name: ITR-1 (Sahaj): income tax return
forms.what: The simplest income tax return form, for eligible individual residents with salary and certain other income.
